title: How Bees Tell Secrets
text:
When a bee discovers a patch of flowers, it does not keep the news to itself. It flies home and begins to dance.
The dance is not for fun. Every wiggle and turn carries information. The direction the bee moves tells the others which way to fly, and the length of the dance tells them how far away the flowers are.
The watching bees crowd close, feeling the movements in the dark. Then they launch themselves out of the hive and travel straight to the spot, without ever having seen it.
A creature smaller than your thumbnail can give directions better than most people can.
